program.name: Pull & Push
program.subject: Pull-ups
program.blurb: Supersets that pair a pull-up with a push: balanced shoulders and lots of bar work.
program.about: Supersets that pair a pull on the bar with a push, so the shoulders stay balanced and the bar gets lots of work. Every pair is a pull-up or hang with a press or push-up, then rest. Two days alternate grips and pushes, and finish with legs. Abs close every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
